policy: Release-admitted source or assets derived from non-npm third parties require an exact local owner, upstream repository and commit, reviewed upstream file identities, SPDX license evidence, modification rationale, and a notice physically shipped with the product. A free-form Source comment is never sufficient release provenance.

modifications: Clean Home and Hide Hot Search retain the upstream selector/behavior concepts but use HALO-owned state, class names, null guards and lifecycle integration.

Stepless Video Rate is a substantial reimplementation: the upstream draggable continuous slider was replaced by a bounded preset menu, and discovery now uses a coalesced MutationObserver/requestAnimationFrame lifecycle with timeout/pagehide cleanup.
Storage ownership moved from biliplus chrome.storage settings to HALO local configuration and the script was consolidated into one SaaT runtime.
